premise.claim: #6197 adds runtime config injection for client-less cache runtimes 'with unit tests and a manual run on kind, but no e2e coverage' (issue #6251); this PR adds the missing Mooncake e2e.
premise.evidence: Tests-only PR (scope carve-out). Coverage gap is real: no other e2e exercises clientless injection. The contracts the new assertions rely on exist on base (runtime.sh generator in pkg/ddc/cache/engine/cm.go — proven by TestRuntimeShContractForMooncakeE2E) and in the still-OPEN PR #6197 (webhook clientless.fluid.io, env FLUID_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH_<DS>). The same dependency makes the PR's own CI red until #6197 merges (see F1).

findings.title: Sequencing: the new e2e fails until the unmerged #6197 webhook lands (all 5 CI kind-e2e jobs red on 74d77d9b)
findings.note: G2 reproduces the CI failure mechanism with a stub kubectl: when admission ALLOWS the missing dataset (today's master, no clientless webhook), check_missing_dataset_rejected panics exactly as CI run 45047215477 shows. The finding's resolution is process-level (merge after #6197); this case guards that the detection keeps working.

findings.title: The e2e hardcodes #6197's still-unstable contract surface (label, webhook name, env suffix, ConfigMap name, denial text)
findings.note: F1/G1 pin the injected-pod shape and the denial message against #6197's runtime_config_injector.go (head b9315aca4). If #6197 changes before merge these fixtures must be updated (Harness-update).

findings.title: Worker entrypoint dropped the explicit file-existence check for the config path
findings.note: E documents observed behavior: a missing runtime.sh aborts via set -e with bash's bare source error. Acceptable but less clear than the old explicit check.

findings.title: Positive guard: worker branch derives identical addresses/quota from runtime.sh as the old jq/runtime.json path
Positive guard: the injection jq filter accepts only the fully-injected pod

liveNote: L3 (skipped per debate setup): on a kind cluster with the #6197 chart deployed, run bash test/gha-e2e/mooncake/test.sh; expect the missing-dataset dry-run to be denied and the rw job to pass with the injected runtime.sh.
